## About
German Automotive Service Center is an independent, full service repair shop in Glendora that works on Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche and Audi. You may know us by our old name, German Car Specialty. Drivers come to us from Covina, La Verne, Claremont, San Dimas and across the San Gabriel Valley.
We're a small shop, so you'll see the faces working on your car. Our technicians are factory trained and ASE certified, and we use original equipment quality parts. We'll let you know about issues that are coming up, tell you what can wait, and help you avoid getting stranded.
Customers often mention Dave by name, for his honesty and for taking the time to explain their options. We're rated 4.7 on Google from 93 reviews.

## Services
- Factory scheduled maintenance: The maintenance your manufacturer calls for, done with original equipment quality parts.
- Oil changes: Regular oil changes that customers describe as consistent and reliable.
- Diagnostics: Computerized diagnostic testing to find what's actually wrong before any work begins.
- Air conditioning repair and service: Keeping your air conditioning working through Glendora summers.
- Windshield wipers to transmission overhauls: Whether your car needs new wipers or a full transmission overhaul, bring it in.
- Car inspections: One reviewer had Dave inspect a car that was for sale, and the inspection was done the same day the seller brought it in.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: German cars: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche and Audi.

Q: Can I bring my car here while it's still under the manufacturer's warranty?
A: Yes. While your car is under the manufacturer's warranty, you may choose any qualified independent repair shop to service it.

Q: Can I check your license?
A: Yes. You can verify our license by looking us up under Auto Repair Dealers with our license number.
